song.title: Fuck Everybody But You
song.description: Angry romance and extreme wedding humour. One song, two cuts: the wedding-table version and my first attempt at cloning my own voice. Same lyrics. Very different guests.
aliases: Fuck Everybody, But I Love You
song.kind: Explicit comedy · angry romance · two versions

lyrics.text:
[Opening]
[Intro — spoken] I said, “Fuck everybody.” You said, “At once?” …That’s when I bought the ring.
[Verse 1] Fuck this town and its fake-ass smiles, I’d walk through hell for you—complain for miles. Brought you roses from a funeral van, He’s dead. I’m driving. Understand?
Your dad said, “Over my dead body.” That’s a venue and a theme for the party. Your momma said, “You could do better than him.” I said, “We both could. Let the wedding begin.”
[Chorus] Fuck everybody, but I love you. Fuck this world—set a table for two. Got a mouth like hell high in high water watch the truth come through: I hate everything. Everyone. Not you.
[Verse 2] Sold Nan’s urn for our honeymoon flight, Pringles tube now—she’s travelling light. “Take me somewhere warm,” she said before— Cremation, then the beach. What you crying for?
The wedding elvis at last vegas said, “Any objections?” Everybody stood. You said, “That’s everybody we expected would.” Stole our own cake, took the cash, left town, You’re laughing in your dress with the windows down.
[Bridge — quieter] Then you fall asleep with your head on my chest, And I stop being angry long enough to rest. No punchline there. Don’t make it weird. Just stay like that. I’m glad you’re here.
[Final chorus] Fuck everybody, but I love you. Burnt the dinner—book a table for two. Still got that mouth, still telling the truth: I hate everything. Everyone. Not you.
[Outro — spoken] Don’t eat those Pringles. That’s your grandmother.
lyrics.snippet: Fuck everybody, but I love you.
